objective: Digitise two changeover checks and one quality-hold workflow for a single work cell
boundary: one work cell; operator UI and local audit trail only

evidence.statement: A local event service exposes three versioned events: order-start, check-confirm, and hold-set with defined timestamps and identifiers.
evidence.limitation: design note does not prove deployed uptime

evidence.statement: Scope is two operator check screens and one supervisor hold/release workflow.
Operators use paper changeover checklists and supervisors sign quality holds.
Local event interface and identity directory have assigned maintainers; deployment and after-hours support owner is not assigned.

constraints: No new PLC access in MVP
